2026_02_LV_LAC.headline: Chargers try to reset as Raiders bring a veteran-heavy lineup
2026_02_LV_LAC.paragraph1: Los Angeles returns home needing a sharper response after a Week 1 loss in which the Chargers turned the ball over and allowed Arizona to sustain too much offense. Las Vegas arrives with a depth chart built around veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins, Ashton Jeanty, Brock Bowers and Maxx Crosby. The Raiders have enough established pieces to punish another uneven Chargers performance, while Los Angeles needs its offense to finish drives and its defense to avoid giving Cousins comfortable, repeatable answers.
2026_02_LV_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles must finish drives and disrupt Las Vegas’ veteran passing structure; if the Chargers control those situations, the Raiders lose their easiest path to sustained possessions.
